description: Colony Autonomy: View colony health score, trend over time, or trigger an on-demand health snapshot. Actions: snapshot (latest health), trend (30-day history), pulse (trigger fresh snapshot). Health score computed from agent distribution, merit averages, deliberation quality, gate efficiency, and constitutional compliance.

action.description: Action: snapshot = latest health; trend = 30-day history; pulse = trigger fresh assessment

institution_id.description: Institution ID for scoped health (omit for colony-wide)
